title: I'm not sure what is wrong — I only know something feels different
intro: Sometimes there's no single symptom — just a feeling that something has changed. That instinct is worth listening to.
reassurance: You don't need to have the answer to take a good first step. That's exactly what this is for.

roadmap.whatsHappeningNow: A vague sense that 'something's off' is often the earliest signal — before any obvious symptom appears.
whatMayComeNext: Gentle attention now can catch a small issue early.
Patterns usually become clearer over a few weeks of observing.
If several small things add up, a fuller look helps.
changesToWatchFor: Subtle shifts in memory, mood, energy, or appetite
Small changes in routines or self-care
Anything that simply feels unlike their usual self
howToPrepare: Start noting what feels different, with dates.
Trust your instinct enough to mention it to their doctor.
Compare observations with other family members.
